preconditions.description: Number of nodes and queries are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and 1 <= ci <= 1000000 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge weights are between 1 and 10^6, and nodes are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(bi == 1 for ai, bi, ci in edges[n-1:])
preconditions.description: The last n-1 edges are from node i to node 1.

preconditions.expression: len(set(ai for ai, _, _ in edges[n-1:])) == n-1
preconditions.description: The last n-1 edges have distinct source nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in queries[1::2])
preconditions.description: Nodes in type 2 queries are within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], int) for i in range(len(output)))
all(output[i] == shortest_path_length(graph, queries[1+2*i][0], queries[1+2*i][1]) for i in range(len(output)))
postconditions.description: Each output corresponds to the shortest path length for the respective type 2 query.
